subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers keep repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a sibling PR with broader renderer coverage and proof?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same approval-copy bug, and this branch still has a native Telegram renderer gap plus a contributor proof gate that automation cannot clear for the contributor.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this branch open, require native Telegram reason propagation and real prompt proof, then use it as the landing path if maintainers prefer the focused diff.

options.title: Promote the broader sibling fix
options.body: Use a proof-positive sibling such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97145 as the canonical path and close this branch only after that path is selected or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this branch open, require native Telegram reason propagation and real prompt proof, then use it as the landing path if maintainers prefer the focused diff.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice centers on one-shot exec approval semantics and how that reason should flow through approval renderers.
